newsitem.title: UK: Reg Vardy Q1 sales volume up 46 pct.
newsitem.headline: Reg Vardy Q1 sales volume up 46 pct.

text.p: Specialist and volume motorvehicle distributor Reg Vardy plc said overall sales volumes rose 46 percent in the three months until August compared with the same period last year.
New vehicle like-for-like sales volumes were up 11 percent, which was double the market growth in Britain, chairman Peter Vardy told shareholders at their annual meeting.

Sales of used vehicles increased by more than 27 percent, he said. Vardy repeated that the current financial year, which ends on April 30, 1997, has started well with profits ahead compared with the first quarter of the last financial year.
Vardy said the company expects to announce new dealerships in due course as negotiations with car manufacturers are at an advanced stage.
"These new dealerships and developments will provide further growth for the group over the next few years, particularly as it takes up to four years for dealerships to mature," Vardy said.
